en.title: Metrics are contracts, not columns
en.shortdesc: From raw warehouse tables to governed metrics: the dbt + MetricFlow stack, layer by layer, with the YAML that does the work.
en.longdesc: Part 2 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: sources, staging, marts, semantic models and metric definitions in dbt + MetricFlow — and why a metric is a versioned contract, not a column.
en.seoDescription: The dbt + MetricFlow model stack: staging, marts, semantic models and governed metrics. Part 2 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine.
